scope: Local design implementation; no backend deployment, publishing, commit or push
outstanding: Rebuilt native development clients with expo-font and react-native-svg
Android and iOS keyboard, safe area and Dynamic Type checks
VoiceOver and TalkBack review on native devices
Native populated, loading, error and restricted states in both palettes and text scales

findings.fix: Tools render in normal flow beneath the header, with a viewport-based maximum of 240 points. The message list and composer remain separate.
findings.evidence: Pre-fix regression failed on the clipped menu; fixed geometry test, attachment/reply draft test, and 200% tools test pass.

findings.fix: Proportional 100%, 140% and 200% preview scaling. Compact groups, navigation, people cards, circle tabs, media choices and gift filters reflow; native groups respond to width and fontScale.
findings.evidence: All 12 palette/width/scale combinations pass. Long-name, complete-control labels and catalogue-height assertions pass. Native Dynamic Type inspection is pending.

findings.fix: Terracotta borders, selected fills, checkmarks or tab underlines and accessible selected/pressed states. Applies to Inbox, interests, activity, polls, topics and gift categories.
findings.evidence: Pre-fix Inbox regression failed because styles were identical. Both palettes now differ visibly; shared selected-text contrast passes.

findings.fix: Decorative dividers and essential control borders use separate tokens. Inputs, outlined controls and media choices use the stronger boundary. Focus, error, success and disabled treatments are explicit.
findings.evidence: Automated checks require 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for essential control indicators against paper and surfaces, in both palettes.

findings.fix: One locally generated 24-point SVG catalogue serves native and preview. IconButton uses a typed icon property; navigation, post actions, media controls and sheet controls share paths and theme colours. The Circles logo and gift artwork remain.
findings.evidence: TypeScript passes all migrated callers. Browser tests confirm like toggling, accessible names and absence of nested button roles.

findings.fix: Local Lora SemiBold titles; system body text and controls. Shared role metrics, 20-point page gutters, card/control/sheet radii and spacing are generated for both renderers.
findings.evidence: Font binary, OFL licence, system fallback and token checks pass. Both exported native bundles contain the 134 KB font asset.

findings.fix: Compact circle identity stays above stable Posts/Events/About tabs; cover moves inside About. Search, library, chat, rules, members and permitted host controls are reached through Circle tools.
findings.evidence: Circle screens are captured in all 12 combinations. Native regression verifies Posts default, Events content, management behind tools and non-member restrictions.

findings.fix: One Home creation action; quiet secondary routes and grouped post actions. Settings has direct Notifications, Safety and account, Catch-up, Interests and Wallet rows. Gift selection and sending are separate, with labelled favourites and a reachable balance/Send footer.
findings.evidence: Gift tests prove selecting/favouriting does not spend coins and Send deducts once. Catalogue retains at least 140 pixels in every matrix combination.

findings.fix: Timeline preference errors live inside their sheet; moderation has one empty state; libraries and topics explain next steps. Paused chat copy respects role restrictions. Decorative avatar frames are neutral; active stories retain expiry and reduced-motion rules.
findings.evidence: Existing mocked native error/retry, permission, draft, deletion-window and story tests pass. Browser expiry and reduced-motion review pass. Physical screen-reader and interruption checks remain pending.

findings.fix: Discovery filters use a sheet, poll options appear only in Poll mode, advanced media editing stays collapsed, circle tools obey local member/owner roles, and leave/report/moderation flows expose confirmation steps. Auth, reporting and moderation simulations are explicitly labelled.
findings.evidence: Browser tests cover conditional poll fields, permission-limited tools, simulated reports without writes, attachment navigation and preserved drafts. Simulations do not validate production services.
